- name: Check for merge conflicts
  run: |
    BASE_REF=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(open('$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH'));print(d['pull_request']['base']['ref'])")
    BASE_SHA=$(git rev-parse origin/"$BASE_REF")
    if git merge --no-commit --no-ff "$BASE_SHA"; then
        git merge --abort
        exit 0
    else
        git merge --abort
        exit 1
    fi
